tools.name: search_open_loads
tools.description: Open loads on the boards right now: route, escort type, pay, date and a link. No company names or contact details. Optionally filter by a state the load starts or ends in.

tools.name: search_open_jobs

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_pilot_car_escorts · Private data: find_pilot_car_escorts, search_open_loads, search_open_jobs · Public sink: search_open_jobs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_pilot_car_escorts · Private data: find_pilot_car_escorts, search_open_loads, search_open_jobs · Public sink: search_open_jobs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pilot_car_guide" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
